7549.title: Native keyboard activation in a split app window
7549.rootCauseOneLine: Not established: native keyboard layout timing remains an unverified hypothesis; both trusted checkouts lacked Apple tooling.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed and unmerged; private UIKit interception has no native regression test. Static diff review only, never executed.

7549.proposedFix: No safe production fix without a faithful native reproduction. Capture the failing keyboard attachment on verified Apple hardware, then design a failing regression before evaluating a mitigation.
7549.caveats: Hardware-blocked, not a refutation. verified records that a second clean checkout confirmed the report's blocked-attempt finding; it does not mean the crash reproduced. Mobile JavaScript suite: 49 files, 356 tests passed.
